title: STEPVEIL 节奏门步进音序器（黑五限时免费）
summary: 节奏同步的步进音序器与 Trance Gate：每一格是连续电平而非简单开关，支持连音、每格概率、8 个 Pattern 槽位之间 morph，还能在包络显示里手绘单格的起音/保持/释音，并用同一闸门扫动共振滤波器；内置 226 个预设。原价 $29，黑五限时免费，需在 2026 年 11 月 30 日前下载并激活。跨平台：macOS 10.15+（AU / VST3 / AAX，Universal 支持 Apple Silicon 与 Intel）与 Windows 10+ 64 位（VST3 / AAX）。
content: A tempo-synchronised step sequencer driving a click-free amplitude envelope, with a resonant filter swept by the same gate. Each step carries a continuous level from closed to open, not a switch, so the same instrument works as a hard trance gate or a rhythmic volume sequencer depending only on how the pattern is drawn. Ties join steps into longer events, per-step probability makes patterns breathe, and eight pattern slots morph between each other. The gate display draws the envelope the engine will actually produce; dragging a step's corners gives that step its own attack, hold and release. The grid is fully keyboard- and screen-reader-operable. Ships with 226 factory presets. Normally $29, FREE for Black Friday - download and activate by 30th November. Formats, macOS: AU, VST3, AAX (Universal: Apple Silicon and Intel). Formats, Windows: VST3, AAX (64-bit). Operating system: macOS 10.15 or later, Windows 10 or later, 64-bit.

title: PULSEDUCK 侧链闪避效果器（黑五限时免费）
summary: 插入式侧链闪避（ducking）插件，不是压缩器：闪避深度由手绘曲线决定，而非从输入电平推导，因此每次触发都一致；可用 Host / Sidechain / MIDI 三种方式触发，既能处理整个信号，也能只让分频点以下的内容闪避、保留低频谐波与音符清晰度；内置 16 条曲线并可自行绘制。原价 $29，黑五限时免费，需在 2026 年 11 月 30 日前下载并激活。跨平台：macOS 10.15+（AU / VST3 / AAX，Universal）与 Windows 10+ 64 位（VST3 / AAX）。
content: An insert ducker, not a compressor: every hit ducks identically. The depth of ducking is drawn as a curve rather than derived from the input's own level, which makes it a rhythmic tool rather than a dynamics one. Place it on a bass, synth, pad or effects return to step that signal out of the way of the kick - either the whole signal, or only the content below a fourth-order crossover, so a bass can lose its sub around the kick while its harmonics and note definition stay put. Three ways to decide when: Host mode runs a free-running envelope against the musical grid, Sidechain mode fires one shot per detected transient, and MIDI mode fires one shot per note-on. Sixteen original curves ship with it, plus your own drawn curves. Zero latency by default. Normally $29, FREE for Black Friday - download and activate by 30th November. Formats, macOS: AU, VST3, AAX (Universal: Apple Silicon and Intel). Formats, Windows: VST3, AAX (64-bit). Operating system: macOS 10.15 or later, Windows 10 or later, 64-bit.

title: 福利：Georgia Tech 免费送出可根据你的歌曲生成新歌曲的 HearMe AI 音乐创作软件
titleEn: 福利：Georgia Tech 免费送出可根据你的歌曲生成新歌曲的 HearMe AI 音乐创作软件
summary: HearMe 由 Georgia Tech Center for Music Technology 的 Robotic Musicianship 团队开发，强调“音乐应被演奏，而非靠提示词生成”。HearMe 会根据键盘、吉他、人声、节拍等用户输入生成歌曲变化版本，供用户继续探索、学习和创作。与仅通过文本提示词生成歌…
content:
Georgia Tech Center for Music Technology 推出了一款 AI 音乐创作软件：HearMe，该软件以用户的演奏、演唱或录音素材生成歌曲版本，并提供可编辑记谱和学习反馈。

HearMe 由 Georgia Tech Center for Music Technology 的 Robotic Musicianship 团队开发，强调“音乐应被演奏，而非靠提示词生成”。HearMe 会根据键盘、吉他、人声、节拍等用户输入生成歌曲变化版本，供用户继续探索、学习和创作。

与仅通过文本提示词生成歌曲的 AI 音乐软件不同，HearMe 会围绕生成的歌曲提供跟奏记谱、鼓组练习、和弦与结构分析，以及多种动态可视化内容。HearMe 由 Georgia Tech Center for Music Technology 创始主任 Gil Weinberg 教授带领开发，重点在于让用户在创作原创歌曲的过程中练习演奏、乐理和作曲。

HearMe 的功能设计参考了关于主动音乐创作的研究，包括其与大脑发展、心理健康、认知及学业表现、社会连接、坚持力、自我认同和创造力之间的关联。HearMe 鼓励用户演奏乐器、演唱并学习乐理和作曲，将实际音乐参与置于创作流程的核心。

HearMe 的特点包括：

HearMe 提供 Record、Upload 和 Play 三种输入方式。用户可通过电脑或手机麦克风录音、上传 MP3、WAV 或 MIDI 文件，或使用连接的 MIDI 键盘及屏幕键盘演奏。HearMe 内置钢琴、吉他、打击乐和风琴等音源，可播放输入软件的 MIDI 内容。

用户可将创作的音乐想法保存至 Library，再通过 Generate 基于录制、上传或演奏的素材生成歌曲版本。歌曲生成后，Piano Roll 和 Chord Display 可显示歌曲结构。

HearMe 的 Lyrics 区域支持输入自创歌词，并可按照音节数量和押韵方式提供替换词与短语建议。用户还可保存词语集合，并将内容拖入 Lyrics 区域逐步编写歌词。

HearMe 还提供 Playground 节奏练习、钢琴练习与演奏反馈、与动画版 Shaia 的互动即兴演奏，以及向 HearMe 社区分享歌曲等功能。

Gil Weinberg 还使用 HearMe 制作了同名新专辑《HearMe》，并以 Gil W. 的名义在 Spotify、Apple Music、Bandcamp 等平台发布。

HearMe 现可免费通过网页软件使用，并有运行在 iPhone 上的应用。

summary: DW-303 对原硬件的振荡器、滤波器、包络和放大器电路进行建模，并提供 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 版本。软件不采用常规虚拟模拟合成架构，而是依据原始电路图，对 TB-303 信号路径的各个阶段分别建模。DJW Audio 表示，开发者还依据硬件实测数据校准模型，包括滤波器共振、Accent 和 S…
content:
DJW Audio 推出了一款 TB-303 风格贝斯合成器：DW-303，该插件通过电路级建模复现 Roland TB-303 的声音架构与 16 步音序工作方式。

DW-303 对原硬件的振荡器、滤波器、包络和放大器电路进行建模，并提供 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 版本。软件不采用常规虚拟模拟合成架构，而是依据原始电路图，对 TB-303 信号路径的各个阶段分别建模。

DJW Audio 表示，开发者还依据硬件实测数据校准模型，包括滤波器共振、Accent 和 Slide 电路的响应特征。

DW-303 提供锯齿波和方波、带共振的梯形滤波器，以及截止频率、共振、包络调制、衰减和 Accent 参数。Full 模式执行完整电路模拟，Economy 模式则提供运算负荷较低的处理方式。

DW-303 也复现了 TB-303 的 16 步音序编辑方式。用户先在 Pitch Mode 中输入音高，再于 Time Mode 中编排节奏；每一步均可设定音符、连音、休止、Accent、Slide 和移调。

DW-303 支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 系统，支持 M 系列处理器，插件格式为 VST3、AU、AAX、CLAP 和 LV2，并提供独立软件版本。

官网可免费下载： https://djwaudio.co/#dw-303

title: In Session Audio 为 Kontakt Player 免费提供 Dyad: Solo Kalimba
titleEn: In Session Audio offers Dyad: Solo Kalimba FREE for Kontakt Player
summary: In Session Audio is offering Dyad: Solo Kalimba, a kalimba sample library for the free Kontakt Player, as a free download through November 25. We’ve previously…
content:
In Session Audio is offering Dyad: Solo Kalimba , a kalimba sample library for the free Kontakt Player, as a free download through November 25.

We’ve previously covered their Fruit Shake giveaways , which focused on sequenced shaker performances. This time, the freebie brings that same performance-focused approach to a melodic instrument, with separate pattern players representing the left and right thumbs.

The sampled kalimba was built from cedar and gourd by instrument maker Greg Trimble. And the virtual instrument includes over 800 samples covering four plucking articulations, with different playing strengths and round-robins of each note.

The Dyad Engine also powers the developer’s Hand Pan Drums library. Its paired sequencers give you separate left and right parts, with controls for the notes, playing style, and rhythmic details. It lets you work pretty fast, so you can trigger a complete pattern from a single key, then adjust swing and humanization to change the feel.

Solo Kalimba includes 100 editable patterns, with space for 24 in each patch. You can filter the collection by time signature, tempo, groove or fill, and complexity.

The Flair feature lets you divide a step into two, three, or four smaller steps. That’s how you can add quick rolls or note sweeps within a pattern without making the entire sequence run faster.

title: Polyend 免费提供 Patch modular effects 采样包
titleEn: Polyend offers Patch modular effects sample pack for FREE
summary: Polyend is offering Patch, a sample pack featuring 101 experimental Eurorack effects, for free with the code PROMOPATCH at checkout. Simply add the pack to you…
content:
Polyend is offering Patch , a sample pack featuring 101 experimental Eurorack effects, for free with the code PROMOPATCH at checkout.

Simply add the pack to your cart and apply the code before completing checkout. Thanks to BPB reader Stan for the info!

The collection is great for a bit of weekend inspiration if you like sounds that sit somewhere between electronic music and cinematic sound design. You’ll find a wide variety of modular sounds, including chaotic noises, deep tones, impacts, and more, organized into dedicated folders.

You can use those movements to connect sections of a track, drop an impact at the end of a transition, or even load some of these in a sampler and play them like instruments. The product page has five audio demos if you want to hear what’s included.

I’ve said this before, including when we covered Polyend’s Bliss Chords , but I appreciate simple sample packs more and more.

My inbox is drowning every day in an avalanche of AI-made VST plugins with bombastic marketing that doesn’t make any sense. Getting something simple and inspirational like this is a breath of fresh air on a Saturday morning.

Created by Polyend Sound Design, Patch contains 101 one-shot samples in stereo at 44.1 kHz and 24-bit resolution.

The updated Player lets you browse and search for presets, then adjust them with a selection of sound-shaping controls. It also includes more than 650 free Starter Presets from other AAS sound packs.

title: Vibe Together：可免费试玩的音乐创作多人游戏
titleEn: Vibe Together turns music-making into a multiplayer game you can try for FREE
summary: Vibe Together is a free-to-start browser music sandbox where up to eight people can build a song together on a shared grid. A Steam edition is coming later, an…
content:
Vibe Together is a free-to-start browser music sandbox where up to eight people can build a song together on a shared grid.

A Steam edition is coming later, and you can wishlist Vibe Together on Steam .

Developed by The Music Unc, Vibe Together has been four years in the making. The idea behind the project is to make creating music feel more like playing a game with friends, and I think it looks awesome.

In Vibe Together, you place musical objects on the grid, connect them with wires, and watch signals travel between them to trigger sounds. The distance between objects determines the timing, so moving a note changes when you hear it. Pitch is represented by color, letting you follow a melody visually as it plays.

You can build a repeating loop or give different branches a chance of playing, so the pattern changes as it goes around. The procedural music system uses your key, scale, and chord progression to generate notes, with editable rules for how melodies move and resolve.

For example, set a rhythm branch to play 70% of the time, and it won’t appear on every pass. You can keep rearranging the connections while the music plays and hear how each change affects the result.

You can simply invite friends through a session link, and everyone can work on the same composition at once. The whole setup can work like an online multiplayer band, where one person can build the drums while another adds a bassline, etc.
